why: Fixes kept adding code that the next fixes then fixed: at 3.13.2 the median fix added 118 lines (30 seven weeks earlier), scripts/ had doubled since 2026-10-01, and 47% of the lines November's fixes changed had been written by earlier fixes. Shipped code does not grow: a change that adds lines removes as many. Lower the number when code is removed; raising it needs the reason in the PR body.
counted: non-blank lines that are not a comment, in scripts/**/*.py and mcp/**/*.py
lowered: 2026-11-20: 34077 -> 34036 (-41): the review page's markup, styles and script moved out of Python strings into scripts/_review.html, which _review.py fills with one JSON document. Then 34036 -> 34016: the English-assumed note and its plumbing went when the English-only model stopped running on speech nobody named. Then 34032 -> 34021 (-11): one shared step refuses a number outside what its option takes (#645), and eight per-tool checks it made redundant went. Then 34021 -> 34018 (-3): three fixes from outside contributors (#644, #561, #567) add 7 lines, and sphere.py's five range checks, which the shared step had made unreachable, go (-10). Then 34018 -> 34008 (-10): seven more unreachable range checks go (-14), and one refusal of an output name that ffmpeg splits into files it names itself (#562) arrives (+4). Then 35025 -> 35022 (-3): share the matrix and range decision in four mixing tools (#696). Then 36039 -> 36038 (-1): the shared step reads a help's "> 0" (#749), and fit.py's own --pad-blur check and the clamps that read 0 as another value go.
fix_size_rule: A fix adds at most this many net lines to scripts/ and mcp/ (added minus removed, Python files). Beyond it, prefer a refusal or removing a mode; a larger fix says why in its ledger entry (size_reason).

budget.rule: Error budget (after Google SRE): over either limit, no change that adds a name to the contract merges; fixes, tests, docs and deletions do. The freeze lifts after two consecutive weekly measurements under both limits (#632).
budget.measured_by: python3 .github/scripts/fix_origins.py --since <first day of the window> --labels <PR labels TSV>
